mapper.sql: CASE WHEN s.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN sub.status != 'ACTIVE' OR site.status != 'ACTIVE' OR site.qualification_status != 'QUALIFIED' OR ps.registration_open = 0 OR s.ticket_published_at IS NOT NULL OR s.score_published_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN #{now} < s.registration_starts_at THEN 'UPCOMING' WHEN #{now} >= s.registration_ends_at THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN s.registered_count >= s.capacity THEN 'FULL' ELSE 'OPEN' END

s.id, s.name, sub.name AS subject_name, site.name AS site_name, site.address AS site_address, AS registration_status, s.registration_starts_at, s.registration_ends_at, s.exam_starts_at, s.exam_ends_at, s.description

exam_session s JOIN exam_project p ON p.id = s.project_id JOIN exam_subject sub ON sub.id = p.subject_id JOIN exam_site site ON site.id = s.site_id JOIN exam_project_site ps ON ps.project_id = s.project_id AND ps.site_id = s.site_id

FROM ( SELECT FROM WHERE AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR sub.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!') ) public_session WHERE (#{status} = '' OR public_session.registration_status = #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT public_session.* ORDER BY CASE registration_status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 WHEN 'UPCOMING' THEN 1 WHEN 'FULL' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, exam_starts_at, id
mapper.sql: site.status = 'ACTIVE' AND site.qualification_status = 'QUALIFIED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_session s JOIN exam_project p ON p.id = s.project_id JOIN exam_subject sub ON sub.id = p.subject_id JOIN exam_project_site ps ON ps.project_id = s.project_id AND ps.site_id = s.site_id WHERE s.site_id = site.id AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND sub.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ps.registration_open = 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT site.id, site.name, site.address FROM exam_site site WHERE ORDER BY site.name, site.id
